To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the optimal solution of smart home scheduling under renewable energy pricing is equivalent to that under the centralized technique, and our renewable energy pricing scheme facilitates the community wide electricity saving.
the proposed pricing scheme can facilitate the reduction of both community and individual electricity bills, which can be computed by the proposed advanced cross-entropy optimization technique.

we have developed a new pricing scheme to achieve the theoretical lower bound in the community wide electricity bills, and the proposed pricing scheme is integrated with the smart home scheduling to facilitate the reduction of both community wide electricity bills and individual electricity bills.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a distributed smart community system, which is capable of achieving the optimal scheduling of electricity loads in a decentralized manner.
the design of an advanced pricing mechanism for smart community systems, which is able to facilitate the reduction of the community wide electricity bills and individual electricity bills.
the pricing of renewable energy to facilitate the smart scheduling inside a smart community.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed pricing scheme can significantly reduce the total electricity bill and the individual electricity bills in the smart community systems.
the proposed pricing scheme can effectively drive the decentralized scheduling to reach the optimal centralized solution, which in turn minimizes the community wide electricity cost.
the renewable energy aware pricing is a very effective tool to reduce the total electricity bill for smart communities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our pricing scheme enables the smart community to achieve the optimal solution with a decentralized smart home scheduling technique, and thus it can be implemented without any additional communication overhead.

we propose a new decentralized smart community system which utilizes a novel renewable energy aware pricing technique to reduce the community wide electricity bills, while at the same time, it is able to achieve the individual electricity bill minimization.
our pricing scheme can be used to reduce the total electricity bill of smart communities by 5.5% on average, and 10% at most.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a decentralized smart community system can achieve the same performance as the centralized one.
the pricing scheme is the key component to achieve the optimal performance of smart home scheduling.

the proposed pricing scheme can be used as an efficient tool in the smart community systems to facilitate the energy scheduling of customers and the electricity bill management of community wide aggregator.
